I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message. I confirmed the Tansley Parcel signed order form is due 3 April, which replaces the date she posted in #central-team this morning. I suggested she fix that post herself so the team doesn't go by the old date.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't post anywhere else. A deadline date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and she had already posted it in this channel, so no approval was needed to repeat it.
